title: PRAY PSALM 91 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: Open your eyes before you check your phone, before another voice reaches you today, before the noise of the world says one word to you, stop where you are. Something is already speaking over your life this morning, and I need you to hear it before you hear anything else. There is a dwelling place. There is a shadow that existed before the sun climbed over your city today. There is a covering that was fastened over your name while you were still [music] sleeping, and the spirit of the living God is drawing your attention to it right now. In this exact moment, because he knew this particular [music] morning would find you here, in this place, at this hour, needing exactly [music] this word. I sense something rising even as I begin to speak. Somebody has been carrying a weight that did not start today. It has been building quietly for weeks, [music] maybe months, and you have been managing it, smiling through it, functioning around it. The Lord says, "This is the morning it breaks. Not next week, not when things calm down. This morning." Lift your hands where you are. It does not matter if you are in a car, in traffic, in a kitchen [music] with food still on the stove, on the edge of a bed you almost didn't leave, in a room with three other people still sleeping. Lift your hands. Because heaven does not require silence, heaven requires sincerity. [music] We have not gathered to discuss God this morning. We have gathered to stand under him. There is a difference between describing a shelter and dwelling inside one. Before this hour is finished, you will know the difference in your own body. Something in me says there is a woman on this line who has been negotiating with an attack for 3 [music] years. Every time it surfaces, she pushes it back down and keeps moving because there are children to feed and a job to keep and a face to put on for people who are watching. The Lord says, "Stop negotiating. This morning you are not managing the enemy, you are evicting him." Psalm 91:1 says, "He that dwelleth in the secret [music] place of the most high shall abide under the shadow [music] of the almighty. Hear that word dwelleth. It is not a visitor's word. >> [music] >> A visitor comes and goes, sits close to the door, keeps one foot outside in case things get uncomfortable. Dwelling is different. Dwelling means you have moved your whole life in, your fear moved out. Your bags [music] are unpacked. You are not passing through the presence of God on your way to somewhere else. [music] The presence of God has become the address. And verse two answers back, I will say of the Lord, he's my refuge and my fortress, my God, in him will I trust. Notice the order. Dwelling comes before declaring. You do not shout your confession into the air and hope the shelter catches up with your words later. You first take up residence and then out of that residence, the declaration rises on his own because you are speaking from inside the walls, not from outside [music] hoping to be let in. This is not a psalm you read. This is an address you move into. And I'm not here this morning to explain the architecture of that shelter to you like a lecture. I am here to walk you into the building. Somebody's [music] morning has been starting with dread for a long time. You wake up already tired, already brazen, already scanning the day for what might go wrong before your feet have even touched the floor. >> [music] >> The spirit says that pattern ends today. You are not waking up to survive today. You are waking up to occupy territory. [music] There is a fire in this word this morning and I need you to let it burn off whatever has been sitting on your chest. [music] Some of you came into this prayer heavy and I'm not interested in you leaving it the same way you arrived. >> [music] >> Say this out loud wherever you are, I dwell. Not I visit, not I sometimes remember, I dwell. Now let the preaching begin [music] because a teaching without fire only informs you, it does not deliver you. David did not write Psalm 91 from a palace balcony with nothing troubling him. This is a man who had been haunted through caves, betrayed [music] by people who ate at his table, chased by an army with orders to end his life before he ever wore a crown. >> [music] >> When David says the secret place, he's not speaking theoretically. He's speaking as a man who knows exactly what it cost to have nowhere else to run and to discover that God himself was the last hiding place he needed. [music] That is why this word carries such weight this morning. It was not written by a comfortable man describing comfort. >> [music] >> It was written by a haunted man describing shelter and haunted people write the most accurate [music] maps of where safety actually is. Some of you are in a season that looks like David's cave. It is dark, [music] it is confusing, people around you don't understand what you are carrying and you keep [music] asking why this is happening to you of all people. I want to tell you the cave is not your address. The cave is only the corridor. The secret place is on the other side of it and you are closer [music] to it than you think. Psalm 27:1 declares, "The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear?" Whom shall I fear? That is not a question asked by someone looking for an answer. That is a question asked by someone who has already searched and found nobody qualified to threaten him anymore. Say it with me, "Whom shall I fear?" Say it again like you mean it because your mouth needs to remember what your spirit already knows. I feel something shift as I say this. There is a man on this line whose [music] finances have been under siege, not because he's lazy, not because he lacks vision, but because there is a covenant of delay working against [music] every door he tries to open. The Lord says this morning that delay has an expiry date and it expires today. Watch verse three of our text. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. A fowler does not attack you directly. A fowler sets a trap and waits for you to walk into it on your own legs. [music] Some of what you have been calling bad luck was never luck at all. It was a [music] snare carefully placed time to catch you at your weakest hour. >> [music] >> But the same verse that names the snare also names the deliverance. God [music] did not show David the trap to frighten him. He showed him the trap to announce the deliverance that was already arranged before the trap [music] was even set. Somebody needs to hear this. The enemy studied your pattern, >> [music] >> but God authored your outcome before the study began. Jeremiah 1:12 says the Lord is watching over his word to perform it. Whatever God has spoken concerning you, he is not casually observing it. He is actively enforcing it. That is not a passive God. That is a God on assignment concerning your life. I declare over somebody's household this morning. Every snare positioned for your children, your marriage, your business, your body catches nothing [music] but air in the name that is above every name. Verse four says he shall cover thee with his feathers [music] and under his wings shall thou trust. >> [music] >> There is something almost embarrassingly tender about that image, feathers. Not steel, not armor plating, not a wall of stone, feathers. Because the same God who is a consuming fire to your enemies is a mother hen to you. >> [music] >> He does not relate to you the way he relates to what is trying to destroy you, [music] to the enemy. He is terror. To you, he is tenderness. >> [music] >> Do not confuse the two and do not let the enemy convince you that a God this gentle towards you [music] could possibly be indifferent to what you are going through. I sense a young woman on this line who has been afraid to trust God with her love life because the last two disappointments nearly broke her. She [music] has been functioning but something in her closed the door quietly without telling anyone. The Lord says this morning, that door is being reopened [music] not by another person's promise but by his own hand and this time what walks through it will not walk back out. Under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Verse 5 continues, thou shall not be afraid for the terror by night nor for the arrow that flieth by day. Night, terror and day arrows, that is every category of attack covered. What ambushes you while you sleep [music] and what comes at you in broad daylight while you are wide awake and doing everything right. Both are named, both are covered. Somebody has been afraid of what happens after dark, the dreams, the sudden dread that arrives with no explanation at 2:00 a.m., the sense of a presence in the room that you cannot name but can feel. I speak [music] to that terror by night this morning, you are evicted. Every night assignment fashioned against this life [music] is scattered by fire in Jesus name. And to the arrow that flies by day, [music] the sudden news, the unexpected diagnosis, the phone call that changes everything in [music] 30 seconds, I decree that no such arrow finds its target in this house, this family, this destiny, [music] this year. Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday. A [music] thousand shall fall at thy side and 10,000 at thy right hand but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shall thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. Verses 6 through 8 are not exaggeration, they are covenant mathematics. 10,000 falling and you standing untouched is not because you are lucky [music] or because you happen to be somewhere else. It is because a line was drawn and the line has your name written on the inside of it. I feel led to speak to somebody whose workplace, whose family [music] compound, whose very street has become a place where things keep happening to everyone around them and they keep wondering when it will be their turn. Hear me clearly. Proximity [music] to a battlefield does not mean participation in the casualties. You can stand in the middle of a thousand falling and remain the one still standing because it shall not come nigh thee is not a suggestion, it is a decree spoken over you before you were born. Say this with your whole chest, it shall not come nigh me. Say it for your children, it shall not come nigh them. Say it for your spouse, for your parents, for the business you have been believing God for. It shall not come nigh them. Because thou has made the Lord which is my refuge, even the most high, thy habitation. Verse 9, there shall no evil befall thee, >> [music] >> neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. Look at that word again, habitation, not habit, habitation. [music] This is not about doing spiritual things occasionally. This is about where you actually live, where your mind [music] actually rests, where your trust actually sits when nobody is watching and no camera is recording your worship. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. Verses 11 and 12, this is not decoration. Psalm 34 verse 7 agrees >> [music] >> saying, the angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that [music] fear him and delivereth Encamped not, passes by occasionally, not checks in once a week, and [music] comes. Sets up permanent residence around you, the same way soldiers set up permanent residence around a border they intend to hold. I see a company of messengers activated over the households on this line right now. I see angelic assignment concerning journeys that have not yet been taken, [music] the travel that is coming, the relocation that is coming. And the new job that will require new movement, and I declare that every journey from this point forward carries an angelic escort, front and back, in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder, the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet. Verse 13. Notice this is not passive protection where you simply avoid danger. This is active dominion where danger is placed underneath your feet. There is a difference between escaping a lion and stepping on one. God is not merely rescuing you from the enemy this morning. [music] He's repositioning you above the enemy. Somebody's assignment this year requires you to walk into rooms that used to intimidate you. Boardrooms, [music] embassies, family meetings, where certain people always try to shrink you. I declare every lion in that [music] room, every adder coiled under that table, is already under your feet before you arrive. Because the verse does not say you will eventually tread. It says you shall tread, present, active, now. Because he had set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him. I will set him on high, because he hath known my name. Verse 14. God is speaking now >> [music] >> in first person, and he's telling you exactly what activates this covenant love and knowledge. Not performance, not perfection. Love that has set itself upon him and knowledge of who he actually is. He shall call upon me and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. [music] I will deliver him and honor him. With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation. Verses 15 and 16. Read that phrase again. I will be with him [music] in trouble. Not I will remove all trouble from his life so he never has to trust me. I will be with him inside it. That is a different kind of promise than most people are asking for. Most people want a life with no fires. God is promising a presence inside the fire so [music] complete that the fire cannot hold you the way it holds everything else it touches. That is exactly what happened in the book of Daniel. Three men thrown into a furnace heated seven times hotter than normal and the king looked in and said, "Did we not cast three men in and [music] I see four? And the form of the fourth is like the son of God." The fire did not spare them by staying away. The fire [music] lost its power because someone was standing inside it with them. Somebody's furnace this season [music] is not being removed. It is being entered by him with you. >> [music] >> And the ropes that bound you will burn off in a fire that cannot touch your body. I declare over this gathering, whatever furnace you are walking into this week, you will not walk in alone [music] and you will not come out smelling of smoke. Now, hear the prayer flow because everything we have said so far has been preparing your mouth for what is about to happen [music] next. Teaching opens understanding. Prayer opens heaven. We move now from hearing the covenant to enforcing [music] it. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for this morning, for breath in our lungs, for a mind that is sound, for a body that responded when we told it to rise. >> [music] >> We do not take this morning for granted because somewhere tonight someone did not wake up and yet we did and that alone is grace we did not earn and cannot repay, only receive with gratitude. [music] We begin with destiny father because so many carrying this prayer this morning have gifts that have never been properly deployed, callings that have been delayed by circumstances that had nothing to do [music] with their obedience. Isaiah 54:17 says no weapon formed against thee shall prosper and every [music] tongue that shall rise against thee in judgement thou shalt condemn. We stand on that word this morning and we say every weapon fashioned against destiny in this place fails. Every tongue that has spoken delay over a life on this line is silenced. Somebody's destiny has been [music] sitting in a waiting room for years watching people who started after them get called ahead [music] of them. I speak to that waiting room this morning. Your name is being called now. Rise and walk into the room prepared for you before the foundation of the world. Habakkuk [music] 2:3 says the vision is yet for an appointed time but at the end it shall speak it shall not lie though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come, it will not tarry. Father we ask you to move the appointed time forward for those who have waited beyond what flesh can bear. We are not asking you to [music] break your timing, we're asking you to remember that some of your children are approaching the end of their strength, [music] not the end of their faith and we ask for mercy that accelerates. I decree over destinies on this line. What took others 10 years will take you a season because God does not owe the enemy an explanation for how fast he chooses to move. >> [music] >> We move now to family father. There are households represented in this prayer where love has grown cold, where siblings have not spoken in years over matters that time has made small but pride has kept large. Where parents watch their children drift [music] and do not know how to call them back. We ask for deliverance over these family lines this morning. We break [music and singing] every generational pattern of division, every inherited habit of silence where conversation should be. Every spirit of strife that jumps from a grandparent to a parent to a child without anyone ever naming it or resisting it. Malachi chapter 4 speaks of turning the heart of the fathers to the children and the heart of the children to the fathers, lest the earth be smitten with a cause. Father, turn the hearts in these families back toward one another. Let reconciliation begin before the sun sets on this very day. I prophesy to somebody's family group chat >> [music] >> that has gone silent, it will not stay silent. Somebody's going to reach out first this [music] week and the eyes that has sat on that relationship for years will begin to crack because we have released a word this morning [music] and the word does not return void. We move to marriage and to those believing for marriage, Father. For the married, we ask for restoration of what has grown distant, the friendship that used to laugh easily, the intimacy that has been buried under bills and exhaustion [music] and unspoken resentment. We ask you to remind husbands and wives on this line why they chose each other in the first place [music] and we ask for grace to choose each other again today on purpose. [music] We break every altar raised against marriages represented in this prayer, every covenant of division spoken over a couple by people who never wanted to see them succeed, every seed of comparison sown by social media, every spirit of suspicion planted by the [music] enemy to make two people who are supposed to be one begin to see each other as opponents. We cancel that assignment now [music] in Jesus' name. For those still waiting, still believing, still watching others walk down aisles while their own story seems paused, I speak to you directly. Ecclesiastes 3:11 says, "He has made everything beautiful in his time, >> [music] >> not in your time, not in your family's time, in his time." And his timing has never once failed a single person who trusted it completely. I decree that the waiting is not wasted. It is preparation. >> [music] >> And what is being prepared for you right now is worth every month it has [music] taken to get you ready for it. Somebody's spouse is being prepared [music] in a location you have not yet visited, going through a process you cannot see, being shaped for a marriage that will not resemble the false start you have survived. [music] Hold on. What is coming knows exactly who you are. We move now to finances, Father, and we thank you in advance because we know you are the God who owns the cattle on a thousand hills and every silver and every gold. Malachi 3:10 [music] invites us to bring the whole tithe into the storehouse that there may be meat in your house, and to prove you now herewith, saith [music] the Lord of hosts, "If I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour [music] you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." We ask for those windows to open over every household on this line this morning, not a trickle, not a slow [music] drip, but a pouring. So much that the containers people have prepared will not be sufficient to hold what is coming. I break every financial gate that has been shut by delay, every contract that has been stalled by unseen resistance, every salary that has been arriving late or arriving short. >> [music] >> I decree that gates open this week that have been sealed for years, and that money owed to somebody on this line, money that has been withheld through injustice, through delay, through outright refusal begins to move toward them >> [music] >> starting today. Deuteronomy chapter 28 speaks of the Lord commanding the blessing upon you in [music] your storehouses and in all that you set your hand on to. Father, command that blessing now over the businesses represented [music] in this prayer, over the small trades, the side hustles, the salaries, [music] the investments that have not yet yielded. The ideas sitting in someone's notebook waiting [music] for capital, release capital, release connection, release the right people to the right vision at the right time. Somebody on this line has been embarrassed about their financial situation, has stopped answering certain calls because they cannot bear another conversation about money they do not have. I speak to that shame this morning, it lifts and I speak to the lack that produced it, it is broken in the name [music] of Jesus. We turn now to health and healing, Father, because there are bodies on this line >> [music] >> that are tired in ways sleep does not fix. And there are diagnosis sitting on some people's chests like stones they carry silently so as not to worry anyone else. We ask for healing this morning, not partial, not gradual where gradual is not necessary, but complete, immediate, undeniable healing. Exodus 15:26 declares, >> [music] >> "I am the Lord that healed thee." Not I was, not I will be eventually. I am, present tense, active right now over everybody represented [music] in this prayer. We call healing into blood conditions, into organs functioning below capacity, into pains that have gone undiagnosed and unexplained for too long. [music] We call healing into minds carrying anxiety that the body has started to manifest [music] as illness. I lay hold of somebody's test results scheduled for this week. I decree they come back different than the fear suggested they would. I lay hold of somebody's chronic condition that has resisted treatment. I [music] decree resistance broken in the mighty name of Jesus. Jeremiah 30:17 says, >> [music] >> "I will restore health onto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds." Some of the wounds on this line >> [music] >> are not physical at all. They are wounds from things said to you in childhood, wounds from betrayal by people you trusted, wounds that have shaped how you see yourself [music] without you ever fully realizing it. Father, heal those wounds, too. Let this morning mark the beginning of a healing that touches the whole person, not only the parts that show up on a scan. Proverbs 4:18 says, "The path of the just is as the shining [music] light that shineth more and more onto the perfect day." I want somebody to hear that word this [music] morning. If nothing else lands your path is not fixed at its current brightness, it grows. What looks [music] dim to you right now, what feels like you are squinting to see even one step ahead, is not your permanent visibility. Light increases on this path, it does not [music] decrease. Whatever darkness gathered around your situation over the past year, I declare that the trajectory of your light is upward, not downward. From this morning forward, Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer onto thee, and will look up." There is something about the morning offering that God responds to differently. It is the first fruit of your day given before the day has had a chance to disappoint you or distract you. Somebody has been giving God the leftovers of your attention, the last 5 minutes before sleep. The guilty afterthoughts squeezed in between meetings. This morning, you gave him the first voice and first voices carry a different weight in the courts of [music] heaven. Now, we moving to warfare, Father, because there are things assigned against destinies on this line that will not leave through gentle asking. They leave [music] through violent authoritative prayer and we're prepared to pray that way right now. We break every covenant made on our behalf without our consent. Covenants made by ancestors before we were born. Agreements spoken in ignorance over family lines that have quietly governed outcomes for generations. [music] Ephesians 6:12 reminds us that we wrestle not against flesh and blood but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. We do not fight the people who have hurt us. We fight what has been using them. I [music] command every evil altar raised against any life on this prayer line in villages, in family [music] compounds, in places some of you have never even visited but where your name has been mentioned. I command those altars scattered by fire. Whatever has been placed on those altars [music] concerning marriages, concerning children, concerning finances, concerning health, we recall it now in the name that is above every name [music] and we set it ablaze with the fire of the Holy Ghost. We cause every cause that has followed a family line without [music] anyone knowing its origin. The pattern of sudden loss, the pattern of premature death, the pattern of marriages that never seem to last past a certain year. The pattern of firstborns carrying burdens they did not create. Galatians 3:13 declares that Christ had redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made [music] a curse for us. We stand under that redemption now, and we declare every inherited curse broken [music] over every household represented in this prayer. I speak now to witchcraft assigned against destinies [music] on this line. Every manipulation disguised as concern. Every controlling voice that has positioned itself as family, but [music] functions as a gate to keep you small. Every dream where you wake up exhausted as though you fought all night because you actually did. Numbers 23:23 declares, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." We decree that no enchantment prospers against anyone on this line, >> [music] >> because you carry the same covering David carried, the same shelter, the same shadow of the almighty over your head. We call for angelic intervention now, Father. 2 [music] Kings 6:17 tells the story of Elisha's servant terrified at the army surrounding them until Elisha prayed, "Lord, open his eyes." And the young man saw the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. Father, open the eyes of everyone on this prayer this morning. Let them see what has actually been surrounding them all along, because most of us have been afraid of a visible threat while an invisible host stood ready and on use [music] simply because we never asked. I release angelic assignment [music] over every journey, every negotiation, every medical procedure, every [music] court case, every job interview scheduled for someone on this line this week. Go before them. Go behind them. >> [music] >> Stand beside them in rooms where they will have no natural advocate and be their advocate in [music] Jesus name. We ask now for restoration of time, Father, because Joel 2:25 promises, "I will restore to you the years that the locusts [music] have eaten." There are people on this line who feel behind behind their mates, >> [music] >> behind the timeline they set for themselves at 20, behind where they believe they should be by now. >> [music] >> We ask you to restore what delay has consumed. Compress the timeline. Let what should have taken a decade happen in a season, [music] not because the process is being cheapened, but because the God who owns time is not bound by the pace the enemy tried to impose. [music] We ask for restoration of virtue also, Father, for those who feel they have given pieces of themselves away in relationships, in compromises, in seasons of desperation that led to decisions they now regret. We ask for the restoration Job experienced, where his latter end was blessed more than his beginning. >> [music] >> Let every person on this line who feels diminished by their past discover this morning that their past does not get the final vote on their future. Finally, Father, we ask for divine preservation. [music] Psalm 121:7-8 declare, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in >> [music] >> from this time forth and even forevermore." We ask for preservation over every going out this week, every trip [music] to work, every school run, every flight, every long drive, and preservation over every coming in, every return home, every homecoming that some of you are still waiting for in a much bigger sense than travel. Preserve marriages from forces working to dissolve [music] them. Preserve children from influences working to reshape their identity away from what you intended. Preserve minds from despair that has been circling certain households on this line for longer than anyone has admitted out loud. Preserve bodies from sudden and untimely harm. We ask for this covering now in Jesus mighty and matchless name. Before we close, I want to speak a few things that are rising in my spirit right now. Words that are not part of anything planned, just what the spirit is highlighting over this gathering in this moment. There is someone who has been praying about a specific relationship for over a year, wondering if you have been wasting your time. You have not been wasting it. Clarity is coming within the next few weeks and it will be clearer than you expected [music] in a way that finally lets you exhale. There is a man on this line who has an idea he has been too afraid to start because the last venture failed publicly and he cannot bear that embarrassment again. This is your season to start quietly and let the results speak later. Do not announce it, just [music] begin. Somebody's mother has been on your heart this morning without an obvious reason. Call her today. >> [music] >> There is something she needs to hear from you and something you need to hear from her before either of you realizes how much time has actually passed. There is a document, >> [music] >> a contract, something official that has been sitting somewhere waiting for a signature. I see movement on it this week. [music] Do not let discouragement stop you from checking on it one more time. Somebody has been having the same recurring dream, always interrupted at the same point, always leaving you unsettled [music] when you wake. That dream will complete itself soon and when it does, you will understand it was never designed to torment you. It was designed to warn you and the warning has already been received in your [music] spirit even before your mind caught up. There is a young person on this line, a student, someone just starting out, carrying pressure to prove themselves that is heavier than what their season actually requires. I speak peace to that pressure. You are not behind. You are exactly where preparation needed you to be. Somebody has been holding an apology in their mouth for months, unsure how to deliver it without losing face. Deliver it this week. >> [music] >> What you fear will break your pride will actually be what repairs the relationship you have been quietly [music] grieving. There is a health concern that someone has been avoiding checking because they are afraid of the answer. Go and check. Whatever it reveals, you are not walking into that report alone. [music] And fear of the answer has never once changed what the answer actually is, only delayed the treatment that could resolve it. >> [music] >> I see someone whose bank alert is about to surprise them this week in a good way after a long stretch of alerts that only ever brought disappointment. [music] Watch your phone. Somebody's court matter, somebody's land dispute, [music] somebody's inheritance case that has dragged on longer than it should have. I decree movement on it before the end of this month in the name of Jesus. There is a woman who has been believing for a child, quietly, without telling most people, and tired of explaining herself to those who ask insensitive questions at family gatherings. I speak life to your womb this morning. What has felt delayed is not denied. Hold on a little while longer. Somebody's peace has been stolen by a relationship that keeps taking without ever giving back, draining your emotions, your time, your resources, and giving you nothing but more demands in return. This is the season that relationship gets repositioned, either restored to health or removed from your daily life entirely, whichever one actually serves your peace. There is someone rebuilding after a loss they have not fully spoken about, a business that collapsed, a friendship that ended without explanation, a version of themselves they buried somewhere in the last hard season. I speak resurrection to what you buried. Not everything that goes into the ground stays there. >> [music] >> Some things are seeds, not corpses, and what you are grieving today is closer to a planting than a funeral. >> [music] >> Before we release this prayer line back into the day, hear this final word. You did not wake up this morning by accident, >> [music] >> and you did not encounter this particular prayer by accident, either. Something new you would need exactly [music] this covering, exactly this reminder, exactly this fire on, exactly this day. Walk into the rest of today like a person who dwells in the secret place, not like a person hoping to eventually find it. Whatever tries to meet you before noon, carry this word into it. [music] Whatever tries to discourage you by evening, remember this fire. You are covered. You are hidden. You are not hidden because you are hiding from anything. You are hidden the way treasure is hidden, kept, guarded, valuable enough to be protected by more than your own strength. Go in peace, but go on fire. Go covered, but go confident. This is your day, and this is your shelter, and nothing assigned against you today will [music] find you unguarded.
